{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 2: Filter to the treatment arm
df_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Step 3: Compute the fraction of patients who responded
n_total = len(df_treatment)
n_responded = df_treatment['responded'].sum()
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_total

# Print the exact numbers that will be used in evidence
print(f"n_total = {n_total}")
print(f"n_responded = {n_responded}")
print(f"fraction_responded = {fraction_responded}")

# Also print the number of duplicate patient IDs for transparency
print(f"Number of duplicate patient IDs (i.e., re-tested patients): {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")"}
